app.title: Catia Toolbox
app.description: CATIA automation toolbox on exported data (no live CATIA): nomenclature identification, conversion to Composer, SMGXML colorization and version comparison.

identification.title: 1 - Identification
identification.sub: Read the nomenclature (.xlsm) and input data (.zip) to identify the CATParts to process.

import.title: Import
import.sub: Scan a local folder or import a CSV / JSON listing.

diff.title: Compare
diff.sub: Detect parts added / removed / modified between two imports.

smgxmlRecolor.title: 3 - SMGXML: color
smgxmlRecolor.sub: Apply the mono-color SIN colors to the SMGXML (dry-run by default).

colorization.title: Colorization
colorization.sub: Assign a color to parts (by state / type / depth).

tree.title: Tree
tree.sub: Metrics and structure of the current import.

suggestions.title: Suggestions
suggestions.sub: Generate a reorganization plan then accept / reject.

export.title: Export
export.sub: Download the plan (CSV) and the reviewable script (.bat / .sh).

smgxmlRename.title: 4 - SMGXML: rename
smgxmlRename.sub: Replace the old part name with the new one in the SMGXML (dry-run by default).

replacement.title: Replacement
replacement.sub: Part replacement plan from a mapping.

qc.title: 5 - Quality Control
qc.sub: Checklist for verifying parts in the assembly.

checks.title: Checks
checks.sub: Run configurable checks on the current import.

settings.title: Settings
settings.sub: Mistral API key and models in use.

checks.title: Checks
checks.subtitle: Run configurable checks on the current import.

conversion.title: CATIA 3D → Composer conversion
conversion.subtitle: Conversion plan (dry-run).
conversion.dryRun: Generates a mapping + a reviewable Python (win32com) script driving Composer (DRY_RUN by default). No conversion is run by the app.
conversion.sourceRequired: Import a folder or a .zip above.
conversion.outputInfo: Flat output: SMGXML + SMGG at the root, the rest moved to "_autres/". Non-destructive: nothing is deleted, your source files are never modified.
conversion.execHint: Runs the script on this PC. "Test" simulates (dry-run, does not call Composer). "Run" drives Composer for real (Composer + pywin32 required). Non-destructive: creates output files, never touches sources.

replacement.title: Part replacement
replacement.subtitle: Replacement plan from a mapping (dry-run).
replacement.dryRun: The POC produces a plan + a CATIA macro skeleton, never executed.
replacement.dropLabel: Drop a CSV or JSON mapping
replacement.sourceRequired: Choose a mapping in the Source.

colorization.title: Part colorization
colorization.subtitle: Assign an RGB color to parts (dry-run).
colorization.dryRun: Generates an RGB color mapping + a reviewable CATIA macro (SetRealColor). Nothing is applied.
colorization.simulation: Simulation — each part in its assigned color:

identification.previewHint: Load the preview, then configure the mapping to enable analysis.

identification.monoDoneApplied: {{mono}} mono-body part(s) out of {{matched}} matched (applied to parts).

smgxmlRecolor.title: Apply color in the SMGXML
smgxmlRecolor.banner: Step 3. Sets the style (Color Ref → Actor.Style, texture applied by Composer from the C: library) and/or the RGB color (SCLIT > Neutral > Actor.Color) of the nomenclature parts. Dry-run by default; applying writes the file keeping a .bak.
smgxmlRecolor.refBanner: Maps each nomenclature "Color Ref" (e.g. Visserie) to an RGB, then written into SCLIT > Neutral > Actor.Color. Falls back to the nomenclature mono color otherwise.

smgxmlRename.title: Rename parts in the SMGXML
smgxmlRename.banner: Step 4. Replaces the old part name with the new one (attributes + references). Dry-run by default; applying writes the file keeping a .bak.
smgxmlRename.mappingRequired: Add at least one old=new mapping.
smgxmlRename.composerRoot: COMPOSER root (contains COMP PROD and COMP PART)
smgxmlRename.batchRequired: Pick both folders and a nomenclature.

data.resetBanner: Irreversible operation. The Mistral configuration (app_config table) is preserved.
